viewing_check: Photograph the stamp on the fixed jaw corner (maker, Sheffield/US/Swedish name, patent) and the beam scale markings (inches, cm, or girth/tally scale). Note beam length, whether the sliding jaw runs freely, any bends or pitting, and whether it is hand-forged (blacksmith made) or a commercial forestry tool.
